intro: Welcome to Quiz Rush! Today we're zooming in on animals. Each photo starts super close, then slowly zooms out. You have ten seconds each. Ready? Let's play!
outro: That's the last animal! How many did you spot? Drop your score in the comments, and come back tomorrow, there's a brand new quiz every day on Quiz Rush!
